build_DataPipeline: build a python module to run the AlphaFold multimer data pipeline on a multi-chain FASTA file
create_convert_monomer_features: create a function to reshape monomer features into multimer model format with chain IDs
create_add_assembly_features: create a function to add asym_id, sym_id, and entity_id features to distinguish protein chains
create_int_id_to_str_id: create a function to encode a positive integer as a spreadsheet-style mmCIF chain ID string
create_pad_msa: create a function to pad MSA features to a minimum number of sequences to avoid zero-sized extra MSA
